title: Garden Stake Diamond Painting Kits! Product Review! #diamondpaintingkits
description:
In this video we'll be taking a closer look at my (2) New Diamond Painting Garden Stake Kits.
Saw these Kits on amazon, and though they would make great Christmas Gifts.
Each Kit includes (8) Acrylic Shapes. 
One with Pretty Butterflies, and the other with Cute Garden Insects.
The Insect kit also includes (3)Tiny Mushrooms which can be added to the end of the Stakes. 
Each Kit comes with the regular Drill Tray, Pink Stylist, Double Square of Red Wax, (5) Small Zipper Bags, and Reg./Crystal Gems. 
Plus to turn your Acrylic Shapes into Garden Stake you also get (8)ea. Foam Circles, Suction Cups, and 12" x 1/4 Dowels.
Thought the Kits were a good Value at $7.99 & $9.97.
All Items were of good Quality.
For more Info see the Photos at the end of the video.
